# Key Technologies.si

> Key Technologies is an AI/SI consulting company run by Shane Christensen, who has more than 42 years of hands-on experience with computers and software, with a background in security, networking and databases. It helps small and mid-sized businesses use AI in practical, safe ways: strategy, automation, AI agents, phone and email assistants, custom software, security and training. Serving Manhattan Beach and Los Angeles, CA and Las Vegas, NV, and working remotely.

Key Technologies works worldwide and can communicate in any language using AI/SI, in writing and by voice. Key Technologies does not guarantee results. Interactive demos on this site use made-up data, are not connected to any real system and do not send, book or charge anything.

## Start here
- [Home: services and free website audit](https://keytechnologies.si/): all 25 services, FAQ and contact
- [Book a free call](https://keytechnologies.si/book.html): request a call time (Mon to Fri, Pacific time); nothing is booked until confirmed
- [Interactive demos](https://keytechnologies.si/key-platform/): a demo for each service
- [For restaurants](https://keytechnologies.si/restaurants.html): guest CRM, phone and text answering, review replies and social content for restaurants
- [For chiropractors and specialists](https://keytechnologies.si/chiropractors-specialists.html): patient CRM, appointment reminders, phone and text answering and a practice dashboard
- [Key Rewards guest events demo](https://keytechnologies.si/key-platform/demos/key-rewards-events.html): share a pool of rewards equally among guests at a restaurant; no cash value, never expire, made-up data
- [Business dashboards demo](https://keytechnologies.si/key-platform/demos/business-dashboards.html): dashboards built around the systems you already use, with made-up data

## Guides
- [PHP2Shell: what small-business website owners should do now](https://keytechnologies.si/guides/php2shell-small-business-websites.html): What the October 2026 PHP security flaws mean for a WordPress or PHP website, and a 10-minute checklist.
- [AI for restaurants: 6 practical ways to save time](https://keytechnologies.si/guides/ai-for-restaurants.html): Six practical uses of AI in a restaurant, what it should and should not do, and a demo of each.
- [What is AI/SI? A plain-English guide for business owners](https://keytechnologies.si/guides/what-is-ai-si.html): What AI and superintelligence mean, what AI can and cannot do for a small business today, and how to tell real help from hype.
- [How to choose an AI consultant: 10 questions to ask](https://keytechnologies.si/guides/choose-an-ai-consultant.html): A plain checklist for small-business owners: ten questions to ask, what good answers sound like, and the warning signs.
- [AI terms in plain English: a glossary for business owners](https://keytechnologies.si/guides/ai-terms-plain-english.html): Short, jargon-free definitions of the AI words business owners hear most, with a note on what each means for you.
- [AI for law firms: where it helps and what a person must still approve](https://keytechnologies.si/guides/ai-for-law-firms.html): Where AI helps a law office, what a lawyer must still approve, and the confidentiality questions to ask before using it.
- [AI for medical and dental offices: where it helps and the privacy questions to ask first](https://keytechnologies.si/guides/ai-for-medical-dental-offices.html): Where AI helps a medical or dental office, what staff and clinicians must still handle, and the privacy questions to ask first.
- [What a business dashboard should show (and what to leave off)](https://keytechnologies.si/guides/business-dashboard-what-to-track.html): A plain guide to what belongs on a small-business dashboard, with examples for restaurants, practices and firms, and how to start.
- [How Key Technologies works with a business, step by step](https://keytechnologies.si/guides/how-we-work.html): What happens from the first free call to a working system, and how you stay in control at every step.
- [AI phone answering for dental and law offices: what it should and should not do](https://keytechnologies.si/guides/ai-phone-answering-dental-law.html): How AI phone answering works for a dental or law office, what it should hand to a person, and what to check before turning it on.
- [How a restaurant rewards program works, and what to check before you start](https://keytechnologies.si/guides/restaurant-rewards-program.html): A plain guide to restaurant rewards: how they work, who pays, what expiry dates mean, and the questions to settle first.

## LVR Rewards (Las Vegas Restaurants)
- [LVR Rewards](https://keytechnologies.si/rewards.html): a rewards program for dining at participating Las Vegas restaurants. Rewards are used only for food at participating restaurants and have no cash value.
- [Rewards demo](https://keytechnologies.si/key-platform/demos/rewards.html)
- [Program terms](https://keytechnologies.si/rewards-terms.html) and [privacy](https://keytechnologies.si/rewards-privacy.html)
